findings.description: Warfield Commons, an 11-tenant arts and media hub anchored by KALW Public Media and the Community Arts Stabilization Trust (CAST), held its grand opening on 27 September 2026 in the 48,313-square-foot former office building the two nonprofits purchased together in 2025. KALW occupies two floors and CAST one; incoming tenants include Psyched! Radio SF and other independent media and literary organizations. A housing conversion of the building had been considered earlier but the developers involved did not secure funding.

findings.description: Chula Cafe opened on 12 September 2026 inside the Dogpatch YMCA, the first commercial food and beverage business to operate inside a YMCA of Greater San Francisco branch in the organization's 175-year history. The Dogpatch YMCA itself opened in May 2025 in a rehabilitated historic industrial warehouse at this address — the 15th Bay Area YMCA location and the organization's first newly built San Francisco facility in 30 years. The cafe overlooks Crane Cove Park with outdoor courtyard seating. The article does not name the building's architect, builder or developer.
